description: This file defines an Akka actor class 'Subscriber' that distributes messages to local subscribers based on topic extraction, and maintains metrics counters for message distribution accuracy.

classes.name: Subscriber
classes.description: An Akka actor class that handles message subscription distribution to local subscribers and maintains message metrics counters.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates and returns the Props object used to instantiate the Subscriber actor, parameterized with message class and topic extractor.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the actor's message handling logic, matching messages of type T for broadcasting and SubscriptionsReader for updating subscriptions.

methods.name: broadcastToLocalSubscribers
methods.description: Sends the message to all local subscribers that match extracted topics, updating true/false positive counters accordingly.

methods.name: updateLocalSubscriptions
methods.description: Updates the actor's internal subscription reader with new subscription data.
